# Step 2 baseline: shipped estimator against the never-moving floor (generated by `python tools/baseline_table.py`; do not edit by hand)

Estimator: `main.py` at 5699f6e (shipped settings + the Step 2 input front end). Floor: `tools/baseline_still.py` (one identity pose per row at the origin), scored the same way. APE = RMSE after SE3 Umeyama fitted on the run being scored. Gap = mean RMSE inside missing-row bursts (>= 5 rows). Blind = RMSE over the last 5 s (exact zeros). Copies: the organisers' `degrade_imu.py` via `tools/official_degrade.py`; reading a = raw EuRoC (gyro first) fed in, reading b = reordered accel first. Tuning sequences: MH_01, MH_02; the rest are held out. Seed 42 (the script's own) is for reporting only.
